title: An Open-label, Multicenter Trial to Assess Safety and Efficacy of a Subretinal Administration of AAVB-039
official: An Open-label, Multicenter, Two Part, Ascending Dose Followed by a Controlled Trial to Assess the Safety and Efficacy of a Subretinal Administration of AAVB-039 in Participants with Stargardt Disease (STGD1) (CELESTE)
summary: Main objective: To determine the safety, tolerability and efficacy of a single administration of AAVB-039 via subretinal injection
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Molecular diagnosis of Stargardt disease due to ABCA4 mutation
2. Aged ≥8 years to ≤55 years inclusive
3. Willingness to adhere to protocol per informed consent
4. No history of vitreoretinal or retinal macular surgery, No current history of cancer for 5 years, No history of myocardial infarct, stroke, or other heart conditions < 6 months
Exclusion criteria:
1. Unwillingness to meet the requirements of the study
2. Participation in a clinical study with another Investigation Medicinal Product
3. Previous participation in another gene or cell therapy trial
4. Any condition that would preclude subretinal surgery
5. Complicating ocular and/or systemic diseases
